mods.name: Breeding Tool
mods.author: Taitsuo
mods.description: Animal genetics and pedigree tracking, breeding predictions and recommendations, with an in-game Advanced Breeding Panel, Breeding Scanner and companion Web Advisor. Full ZIP package: BreedingTool v1.1.0 (UE4SS Lua) and AdvancedBreedingPanel v1.0.1 (PAK). Requires UE4SS v3.0.1-1181-g83330635, installed separately. Install the Lua component manually; IMM is optional for importing and installing the included PAK. See README for installation instructions.
